cohort: 738 women with singleton, cephalic term deliveries who underwent induction of labor.
finding: A nomogram based on obstetric factors and fetal head circumference by ultrasound effectively predicts cesarean following induction of labor, with fetal head circumference being the most predictive ultrasonographic factor, demonstrating favorable net benefits for clinical decision-making.
mod_finding: The developed nomogram significantly predicts the likelihood of cesarean following induction of labor, identifying fetal head circumference as the most predictive ultrasonographic factor for this mode of birth.
